Button.description: A native `<button>` with `type="button"` by default. While disabled your own click, pointer-down, mouse-down and key handlers don't run. For another element, spread the `button` props function on it.

props.disabled: Whether the button is disabled. It gets the native `disabled` attribute, or `aria-disabled` with `focusableWhenDisabled`. `disabled={pending? value}` disables it while a request is out. A natively disabled button that had focus takes it back when it is enabled again, if focus hasn't moved elsewhere.
props.focusableWhenDisabled: Whether a disabled button stays focusable and keeps its place in the Tab order. It is then disabled with `aria-disabled="true"` and ignores presses, Enter and Space.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present while the button is disabled, whether through `disabled` or `aria-disabled`.
